items.caption: A modern redraw of 花 in a seal-script style associated with the received Shuowen text. It illustrates a seal-style rendering, not an early artifact or a dated stage in the graph’s development.
items.alt: Black seal-style 花 form on a white background, with plant-like strokes above and a curved lower element.
items.selection_reason: The image visibly supplies a seal-style rendering of 花. Its association with the received Shuowen style makes it relevant as a later graphic reference, while the sources do not establish it as evidence for 花’s earliest formation.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw, not an ancient artifact image; it cannot establish when 花 arose or a continuous graphic sequence from 𠌶 or 華.
The relationship between this seal-style rendering and the received Shuowen analysis of 𠌶 and 華 is not settled as a history of 花’s graphic formation.
